info.text:
Your Google profile has 5 settings most businesses forget.
How we handle local search: https://ka-performancefl.com/services/seo-ai-search/?utm_source=facebook&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=2026-10-05

1. Primary category: pick the most specific one on Google's list.
2. Hours: confirm them, and set holiday hours before November.
3. Services: list what you actually sell.
4. Photos: add fresh ones of the real place and the real work.
5. Reviews: reply, short and helpful, good ones and bad ones.

Every tip comes from Google's own Business Profile help pages. The category and hours in the video are our own profile, captured as Google shows it; the rest are drawn examples.
